library.title: Library
library.hint: Drag equipment onto the canvas (or double-click it). Then drag a link from an output port, on the right of a block, to an input port, on the left.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.empty: Select equipment or a link to see its properties.
inspector.name: Name
inspector.userSource: custom model, values entered by the user.
inspector.saveTemplateHint: Adds this block to "My models" to reuse it in other projects

direction.msg: Two outputs or two inputs connected.
direction.fix: Connect an output to an input.

signal-mismatch.fix: Check the port or add a converter.

level-mic-to-line.msg: Mic level into a line input (+4 dBu).
level-mic-to-line.fix: Use a preamp or a mic input.

level-line-to-mic.msg: Line level into a mic input: risk of clipping.
level-line-to-mic.fix: Use a line input or a pad.

level-speaker-to-line.msg: Amplified speaker output into a low-level input: risk of damage.
level-speaker-to-line.fix: Connect the speaker output to a passive speaker.

level-line-to-speaker.msg: Unamplified signal into a passive speaker.
level-line-to-speaker.fix: Add an amplifier or use a powered speaker.

adapter-needed.fix: Plan an adapter or a dedicated cable.

input-busy.msg: Several sources on the same input.
input-busy.fix: Use another input or a mixer.

output-busy.msg: This digital or network output feeds several destinations.
output-busy.fix: Add a distribution amp, a switch or a router.

output-split.msg: Analog output shared between several inputs.
output-split.fix: Check impedance or use a splitter.

phantom-missing.msg: Condenser mic on an input without 48 V phantom power.
phantom-missing.fix: Use a mic input with phantom power, or an external phantom supply.

phantom-unknown.msg: Condenser mic: check that the input provides 48 V phantom.
phantom-unknown.fix: Enable 48 V on the input, or set the port's phantom capability.

cable-mismatch.msg: The cable "{{cable}}" does not connect {{from}} to {{to}}.
cable-mismatch.fix: Choose a compatible cable in the link inspector.

pair-busy.msg: Pair {{pair}} of multicore {{cable}} is already used by another link.
pair-busy.fix: Choose a free pair in the link inspector.

pair-range.msg: Pair {{pair}} does not exist: multicore {{cable}} has {{pairs}} pairs.
pair-range.fix: Choose a pair between 1 and the pair count, or enlarge the multicore.

pair-missing.msg: Link assigned to multicore {{cable}} without a pair number.
pair-missing.fix: Choose the pair used in the link inspector.

channels-over.msg: {{n}} channels carried for a declared capacity of {{max}}.
channels-over.fix: Reduce the number of flows, or check the port capacity.

dock.noIssues: No issues: all links are compatible.
dock.missingPower: {{n}} item(s) without declared power: minimum total.
dock.noMulticore: No multicore yet. Create one, then assign links to its pairs from the inspector.

settings.infoHint: These details appear in the title block of PDF sheets.
settings.author: Author
settings.zonesHint: The zone code prefixes cable numbers (2 to 6 letters or digits).

settings.titleBlockHint: Project title block. Empty fields are completed from this computer's template.

merge.title: Merge another version
merge.hint: Version to merge: "{{name}}". Here is what the merge will change in the open project.
merge.nothingAdded: Nothing new in the other version.
merge.renumbered_one: {{count}} added link gets a new cable number (duplicate).
merge.renumbered_other: {{count}} added links get a new cable number (duplicates).
merge.noConflict: No element changed on both sides.
merge.limit: Limit: a deletion made in the other version is not carried over (the element stays). The merge can be undone with Ctrl+Z.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.intro: The assistant helps you build and check your diagram. It only places equipment from the library and has its proposals checked by the rules engine. It stays off until you set it up: local AI on your computer, or your own AI account.
ai.hello: Ask a question or describe the system you need. Proposed additions are shown as a preview: nothing changes until you accept.
ai.desktopOnly: The assistant works in the desktop app: it sends the requests and keeps the key in the system keychain.
ai.placeholder: Your question (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ai.sentTo: Your messages and the relevant parts of the diagram are sent to {{provider}}.
ai.proposalIssues_one: {{count}} rules engine warning on the proposed links
ai.proposalIssues_other: {{count}} rules engine warnings on the proposed links
ai.applyHint: Applying is a single step: Ctrl+Z undoes it.
ai.proposalStale: The diagram changed since the proposal: it was not applied. Ask the assistant again.

suggest.review: Check my diagram and tell me what is missing
suggest.concert: Draft a diagram for a small concert: 4 mics, a console, two powered speakers
suggest.di: Why use a DI box on a keyboard?

error.auth: Key rejected by the provider: check it or create a new one.
error.billing: API billing not enabled or credit exhausted with the provider.
error.rate: Too many requests: try again in a moment.
error.server: The provider returned an error: try again later.
error.network: Cannot connect (network, local server stopped, or desktop app required).
error.steps: The assistant did not conclude after several steps: rephrase or split your request.

setup.title: AI assistant: setup
setup.chooseHint: Two options, same assistant. You can switch at any time.
setup.localDesc: Free, offline, no data leaves the computer. Decent quality, limited by the model size. Needs a fairly recent computer.
setup.accountDesc: Best quality (large models). Billed per use by your provider, with your own API key. Internet required.
setup.serverHint: Pick the software that runs the model on your computer, then detect it. It must be running with at least one model installed (able to call functions).
setup.downloadLater: Downloading a model from AV Diagram comes in a later version. Meanwhile, use Ollama or LM Studio, or llama-server with a .gguf model you downloaded.
setup.noModel: Connected, but no model is installed on this server.
setup.localModelHint: Prefer a multilingual model that can call functions (tools).
setup.testHint: Last step: a simple question to check that the model answers.
setup.testQuestion: What is the nominal level of a professional balanced audio line?
setup.providerHint: Pick the provider of your AI account.
setup.subscriptionWarn: A chat subscription (Claude Pro or Max, ChatGPT Plus, Gemini) does not include API access. You need an API key, billed separately, per use.
setup.createHint: Open the {{provider}} console, sign in, enable API billing, then create a key and copy it.
setup.geminiNote: Gemini offers a limited free tier. Check its terms, in particular how your data may be used.
setup.keyHint: The key is stored in the system's secure keychain, never in a file. AV Diagram never shows it again.
setup.keyPresent: A key is stored for this provider.
setup.keyOptional: Optional key, for a server that does not require one.

shape.spaces: The key contains spaces: check the copy and paste.
shape.prefix: A key from this provider normally starts with "{{prefix}}". Check the copy and paste.

setup.connectHint: A small request (model list) checks the key, billing and access to the service.
setup.costHint: Each question is billed by the provider according to its length and the length of the reply. See the rates on its console.
setup.dataHint: Sent to {{provider}}: your messages, a summary of the diagram and the device sheets the assistant reads. Processing may take place outside the European Union.
setup.consent: I agree to send this data to {{provider}}.
setup.managedHint: Pick the llama-server program (llama.cpp archive for your system) and a .gguf model. AV Diagram starts the server on your computer (127.0.0.1) when you ask a question, and stops it on exit.
setup.launching: Starting llama-server and loading the model (up to 3 min)…

ai.preview: Assistant preview: {{equipment}} device(s) and {{links}} link(s) proposed, dashed

routing.label: Auto routing
routing.hint: Automatic link routing: avoids blocks and spreads overlapping cables

layers.label: Layer
layers.hint: Show a single domain. Per workstation: everyone can work on their own layer in the same project.
layers.hintText_one: {{count}} unconnected {{layer}} port: a connection may be needed.
layers.hintText_other: {{count}} unconnected {{layer}} ports: connections may be needed.

collab.title: Work together
collab.hint: Several computers work on the same project at the same time over the local network (venue network, office, VPN). No data leaves the network, no account.
collab.name: Your name (seen by others)
collab.hostDesktopOnly: Working together uses the AV Diagram desktop app (Windows or macOS), installed on each computer. Windows and Mac computers can work together in the same session.
collab.hostHint: This computer opens the session with the current project. Then share the address and code with the other participants.
collab.joinHint: Address and code shown on the computer hosting the session.
collab.joinWarning: The session project replaces the project open on this computer: save it first if needed.
collab.firewall: If nobody can connect, allow port {{port}} (TCP) in this computer's firewall.
collab.undoHint: Undo (Ctrl+Z) only reverts your own changes.

status.reconnecting: Connection lost, reconnecting… (you can keep working)

error.code: Code refused (or too many attempts: wait a minute).
error.timeout: No answer from the host: check the address, port and firewall.

collab.backup: This computer can take over if the host disconnects (it then opens the session on port 4455)
collab.relayHint: The original host is unreachable: this computer runs the session in its place. As soon as the host is back, everyone rejoins it automatically.

resume.title: Interrupted session
resume.hintHost: You were hosting “{{name}}” (state saved on {{date}}). Resuming reopens the session with the same code: participants reconnect on their own and their changes are merged.
resume.hintGuest: You were taking part in “{{name}}” (state saved on {{date}}). Resuming reopens this project and reconnects as soon as a relay answers.

layers.title: Reserved layers
layers.hint: Reserve your layer: others can no longer change it by mistake. Shared equipment (e.g. a camera with audio inputs) can still be moved and wired on its free ports.

chat.title: Session chat
chat.placeholder: Message (Enter to send, Shift+Enter: new line)

notice.hostLost: Host unreachable. Your work is kept on this computer; you can keep working, reconnection is automatic.
notice.relayLost: This computer's relay is not answering; retrying.
notice.reconnected: Reconnected: changes made during the outage are merged.
notice.relayActive: Backup relay active: the other participants reconnect to this computer.
notice.tookOver: The host is not answering: this computer took over ({{address}}). The others reconnect automatically.
notice.handedBack: The original host is back: the session moves back to it.
notice.ended: The host ended the session. The project stays open on this computer.
notice.kicked: The host removed you from the session. The project stays open on this computer.
notice.locked: Change refused: the {{layer}} layer is reserved by {{name}}.

pdfImport.title: Import of the diagram “{{name}}”
pdfImport.readError: Cannot read the PDF (protected, damaged or not a PDF).
pdfImport.raster: This page only contains an image (scan, screenshot or bitmap export): no readable boxes or lines. Automatic interpretation needs a vector PDF (direct export from the original software, not a scanned print).
pdfImport.hint: Boxes with text = equipment, lines between two boxes = links, text at a box edge = ports. Check, correct, untick what should not be imported. Hover a row to see it on the preview.
pdfImport.name: Name
pdfImport.useTemplate: Start from the {{label}} sheet (manufacturer ports, drawn ones matched by name)
pdfImport.noLinks: No link: title block, legend or standalone equipment? Unticked by default.
pdfImport.signalsToCheck_one: {{count}} link with no signal clue: to check.
pdfImport.signalsToCheck_other: {{count}} links with no signal clue: to check.
pdfImport.unresolved_one: {{count}} line attached to a single box or to more than two (off-page reference, bus): not imported.
pdfImport.unresolved_other: {{count}} lines attached to a single box or to more than two (off-page references, buses): not imported.

exportPdf.title: Export the PDF sheet
exportPdf.titleBlockHint: Title block fields for this issue. They are prefilled from the project and from this computer's template (Settings, Title block template), and kept in the project.
exportPdf.noTemplate: No title block template on this computer (company, logo): fill it once in Settings, Title block template tab.
exportPdf.changeTitle: Size changed: {{from}} to {{to}}. What should happen to the diagram?
exportPdf.choiceFitHint: Each sheet fits on one page; the largest diagram is printed at about {{scale}} % of its print size.
exportPdf.choiceTileHint_one: The diagram stays at {{scale}} %: {{count}} {{paper}} page in total.
exportPdf.choiceTileHint_other: The diagram stays at {{scale}} % and may overflow: {{count}} {{paper}} pages in total, to assemble (marks A1, B1...).

mode.fit: Scale to fit (1 page per sheet)

exportPdf.fitHint: The largest diagram is printed at about {{scale}} % (100 %: 1 diagram unit = 0.25 mm).
exportPdf.tileHint_other: {{count}} {{paper}} pages in total (up to {{max}} for one sheet): the page split is drawn as dashed lines on the canvas.
exportPdf.watermarkImages: Also apply to PNG and SVG exports
exportPdf.zoneDiagramHint: Burnt into the diagram pixels: it cannot be removed without retouching the image.
exportPdf.zoneSheetHint: Drawn as text across the whole sheet, title block included: visible everywhere, but a PDF editor can delete it. Combine with protection.
exportPdf.protectHint: Without an open password, the PDF opens everywhere and the rights above are enforced by readers (Acrobat, Preview, browsers): it is a deterrent. With an open password, the content is unreadable without it (AES-256). Empty owner password: random, nobody can lift the restrictions. Passwords are not saved.
exportPdf.protectDesktopOnly: Protection is done by the desktop app.
exportPdf.samePasswords: Both passwords must differ: the owner password lifts all restrictions.
exportPdf.recipients: Named watermark: recipients (one per line, optional)
exportPdf.recipientsPlaceholder:
City of Lyon - J. Martin
Lighting crew - S. Petit
exportPdf.recipientsHint_one: {{count}} file, in the recipient's name. The name replaces {recipient} (appended to the text otherwise).
exportPdf.recipientsHint_other: {{count}} files, one per recipient, saved in the chosen folder. Each name replaces {recipient} (appended to the text otherwise): if a copy leaks, the watermark identifies it.

levelHint.none: the PDF opens, copies and edits freely; only the watermark, if on, remains.
levelHint.deterrent: the PDF opens everywhere; copy and editing are blocked by common readers, but a specialised tool can lift these restrictions.
levelHint.strong: content encrypted (AES-256), unreadable without the open password. Send it through another channel than the PDF.

titleBlock.title: Title
titleBlock.subtitle: Supplementary title
titleBlock.author: Created by
titleBlock.autoFields: Filled at export: title (project name), date of issue (computer date), sheet number.
titleBlock.templateHint: Template for this computer: it prefills the title block of every project (empty fields only). The date of issue is always the computer date at export time.
titleBlock.logoTooBig: Logo too heavy for this computer's storage: choose a lighter image.
titleBlock.dateAuto: Date of issue: computer date, added automatically at each export.
